description: This file defines the PhotoRecorder class, which manages webcam video input, device selection, photo capture, and cleanup.

classes.name: PhotoRecorder
classes.description: A class for capturing photos from a webcam, managing device selection, and handling video stream lifecycle.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the device supports video input (camera).

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Sets the active video input device by device ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the video input devices and prepares the video and canvas elements.

methods.name: takePhoto
methods.description: Captures a photo from the video stream and returns it as a File object.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Stops the video stream and cleans up DOM elements.

methods.name: awaitVideoReady
methods.description: Waits until the video element is ready to play.
